seo.title: Cosider
seo.description: Track the full project lifecycle, from planning to maintenance.

nav.docsDescription: API reference and product documentation for Cosider.
nav.guideDescription: Step-by-step guides to set up workspaces and projects.

hero.title: From planning to maintenance, in one project
hero.description: Cosider links requirements, tasks, APIs, and tests across the software lifecycle. Follow planning → design → implementation → testing → deployment in a single workspace.

features.title: Scattered artifacts, one thread
features.description: Docs, boards, and specs don't need to live in different tools. Cosider makes them point at each other inside the same project.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.description: Requirements, tasks, API specs, and tests stay linked. See where work came from and how it is verified, on one screen.

gate.title: SDLC stage gates
gate.description: From Waterfall to Scrum and Kanban, each project type gets matching stages and required artifacts. You pass the gate before moving on.

docs.title: Documents and whiteboards
docs.description: Write requirement docs and whiteboards in the same project. Objects map straight to requirements and tasks.

workspace.title: Workspaces and roles
workspace.description: Split team spaces by slug and assign roles from Owner to Viewer. Projects are identified by key inside each workspace.

cta.title: The whole project lifecycle in one place
cta.description: Create a workspace and trace work from requirements to release.

footer.tagline: Track projects from planning to maintenance.
